CHECK ((((kind = 'Practical'::lesson_kind) AND (group_membership_revision IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'Theory'::lesson_kind) AND (group_membership_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (group_membership_revision > 0))))

CHECK ((((resolved_at IS NULL) = (resolved_by_user_id IS NULL)) AND ((resolved_at IS NULL) = (resolution_note IS NULL)) AND ((resolved_at IS NULL) OR (resolved_at >= raised_at))))
CHECK (((((ends_on IS NOT NULL))::integer + ((occurrence_count IS NOT NULL))::integer) = 1))

CHECK ((((frequency = 'Daily'::recurrence_frequency) AND (COALESCE(cardinality(weekdays), 0) = 0)) OR ((frequency = 'Weekly'::recurrence_frequency) AND (weekdays IS NOT NULL) AND ((cardinality(weekdays) >= 1) AND (cardinality(weekdays) <= 7)) AND (weekdays <@ ARRAY[(1)::smallint, (2)::smallint, (3)::smallint, (4)::smallint, (5)::smallint, (6)::smallint, (7)::smallint]))))

CHECK (((planning_start IS NULL) OR (planning_end IS NULL) OR (planning_end >= planning_start)))
CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['Ready'::request_status, 'Confirmed'::request_status])) OR (generated_at IS NOT NULL)))

CHECK ((((severity)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Hard'::character varying, 'Preference'::character varying])::text[])) AND (((source_kind)::text <> 'Legal'::text) OR ((severity)::text = 'Hard'::text))))
